scene.text: Traditional Chinese ink-and-watercolour painting: confident dark ink-brush linework, loose expressive brushwork, soft bleeding colour washes, visible paper grain. Faces, hands and skin are built the same way as everything else — flat washes and visible brushstrokes, edges left unresolved where the brush lifted. Wide aerial shot looking steeply down from a high vantage point onto a large curved stone plaza or public building exterior, where two figures walk separately across the ground-level pavement; the figure in the foreground carries a vivid red-pink open umbrella and wears dark clothing, while the second figure a few metres behind walks without an umbrella in dark clothing. The setting features broad curved horizontal ridges or steps in grey stone, with a large white banner or flag hanging from a structure at the upper right bearing a partially visible logo or emblem.
